description: Developer-assistant request triage: what the user wants done, which language/format, how big the job is. (v2: has_input and needs_tool removed - measured at chance level (55%); has_input is a regex job, needs_tool follows from task.)

task.instructions: What is the user asking the assistant to do?

criteria.validate: check whether a given input (JSON, YAML, code, config, regex, SQL) is valid or correct
criteria.write_code: write, generate or implement new code, a script, a query or a schema
criteria.fix_bug: find or fix an error, exception, crash or wrong behaviour in existing code
criteria.explain: explain a concept, API, error message or piece of code
criteria.convert: convert or transform data or code from one format, syntax or language to another
criteria.run_command: run a command, tool, test or script, or operate on files, packages or processes
criteria.chat: small talk, thanks, or anything that is not a development task

language.instructions: Which programming language or data format does the request concern?

criteria.other: another language or format (YAML, XML, regex, CSV, ...)

effort.instructions: How much work is this request?
